summary: summarizeEmerging's cohort cutoff is inclusive: a trial that started in the cutoff year, current year minus --recent-years, belongs to the recent cohort and its interventions and conditions are tallied as recent. RecentSinceYear reports that same year. A reprint must keep the comparison inclusive and the reported year equal to the one the split uses.
reason: The existing emerging corpus places no trial near the cutoff, so an exclusive comparison, a cutoff moved by a year, or a reported year off by one all passed every test. A hand-authored test in its own file puts trials on and beside the cutoff.
validated_outcome: Three mutations of emerging.go pass the suite before this change and fail the new tests: >= to >, the cutoff one year later, and RecentSinceYear reported as cutoff+1. Sending undated trials to the prior cohort fails only the existing tests, so the two files guard separate rules.
